newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends easier vs basket, steady vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends easier vs basket, steady vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed slightly weaker against the central bank's basket but little changed against the dollar on Friday, dealers said on Friday.

The Hungarian unit closed trading at 192.53/58 against the U.S. unit compared with an opening of 192.50/55 and some 22 fillers off the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid), traders said.
They added that the forint traded 22 to 25 pips off the NBH bid throughout the session in average activity but that the gap was likely to close gradually next week.
The forint, which usually trades right on the central bank's resistance level, opened the gap on Wednesday due to the Polish currency's fall triggered by the country's trade deficit and flood damage.
However, most market participants said the effect on the domestic forex scene would subside as Hungary's fundamentals did not warrant a forint weakness.
(The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention band, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the German mark.)
